answer: Gate admission with an all-pay auction for a fixed quota of identity slots: every applicant posts a sealed bid that is forfeited even when it loses. One honest agent pays a single bid, but an operator spawning hundreds of sybils burns capital on every losing seat, so their outlay drains away like rainwater vanishing into karst. Each forfeited bid leaves a glowing ember of sunk cost on fakes, while legitimate newcomers enter at the slow, rooted pace of spreading yarrow rather than as an instant scripted swarm.
